dialogues.speaker: Pauline
dialogues.text: We sell all sorts of fresh flowers and plants here — looking to buy a few bouquets?

response.speaker: Pauline
response.text: But I'm a resident of Springvale, and I run a small flower shop.

response.speaker: Pauline
response.text: I'm always busy looking after the flowers and plants, so I haven't had any dealings with visitors from outside the town in a long time...

response.speaker: Pauline
response.text: I never thought I'd meet a celebrity like you this year. Perhaps it's good luck brought by the returning wind?

response.speaker: Pauline
response.text: I'm a keen gardener — the plants you see here? I grew them all myself. They're less common varieties that are purely ornamental.

response.speaker: Pauline
response.text: My hope is that such beautiful plants will lift everyone's spirits.

response.speaker: Pauline
response.text: However, because of their seasonal nature, I can only open for business at certain times of the year.
